## History

Joe Sloane is a minor figure in the lives of Avonlea's residents. He is mentioned by Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) in connection to local community gossip regarding the behaviors and opinions of the village's school children.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P4](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0004), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P6](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0006), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P7](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0007), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P8](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0008), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P10](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0010), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P14](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0014), +20 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--joe-sloane.md)

Joe Sloane is a student in Anne's school class. He is present during a chaotic school day when [Anne](../character/anne.md) suffers from a severe toothache and loses her temper. Their relationship is defined by this classroom dynamic under her instruction.
